reviewer: Agent visual review of eight actual native framebuffer PNGs, independently opened for inspection; not a participant usability study
observations: Compact 800x600 selected-disk list has an obvious whole-row selection, readable instructions and distinct Back/Next/Disk tools without overlapping hit targets
Actual 3840x2160/200% Review has a readable summary, consistent typography and explicit final Install action
Start has recognizable original app/folder icons, clear selection/search and bounded controls; taskbar overflow remains within the viewport with readable labels and its own footer
Real 4K desktop icons and bounded multi-line names remain readable with selected Recycle Bin visibly distinct; expected long-name ellipsis preserves grid spacing
Common 4K Files navigation has Back/Forward/Up, location, Places, real USB folder content and a separate status/footer

High-contrast picker and notification now have visible white outer boundaries on black; Focus help is an intentional modal overlay, retains a readable focused action and does not claim screen-reader support
limits: Selected-state agent review is distinct from a human usability study or an exhaustive visual proof of every possible document/device/theme.
Named actual framebuffers only; the clipped cursor tip at the final physical pixel and logical partition-tool minimum remain documented.
